title: Ogyges
summary: Raleigh names Ogyges in the History of the World (1617) and says he was born 67 yeeres after Jacob.
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). He says Ogyges was born 67 yeeres after Jacob. That figure is not a yeere of the World. His birth is calculated as 67 years after Jacob's tier birth in 1836 BC, which is 1769 BC. The year is calculated, and a printed year would replace it.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Jacob's tier birth is 1836 BC (ussher-jones). Raleigh says Ogyges "was borne 67. yeeres after him" (Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, §. II, sig. 94b). 1836 BC + 67 years = 1769 BC. No year 0. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, §. II, sig. 94b
calculated.arithmetic: Jacob's tier birth is 1836 BC (ussher-jones). Raleigh says Ogyges "was borne 67. yeeres after him" (Book I, Part I, Chapter VII, §. II, sig. 94b). 1836 BC + 67 years = 1769 BC. No year 0.

birth.note: Body intake. “him” is Jacob, named in the same sentence. Not a yeere of the World. Not placed on flood-of-ogyges. See N6.
